mapper.select: SELECT id FROM watchlist_groups WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_groups (user_id, name, is_default, sort_order) VALUES (#{userId}, '관심 종목', 1, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT w.id, w.symbol, s.name, s.name_ko AS nameKo, s.is_active AS active, p.close AS currentPrice, CASE WHEN q.close IS NULL OR q.close = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND((p.close - q.close) / q.close * 100, 2) END AS dayChangeRate, p.trade_date AS asOf FROM watchlists w JOIN stocks s ON s.symbol = w.symbol LEFT JOIN daily_prices p ON p.symbol = w.symbol AND p.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = w.symbol) LEFT JOIN daily_prices q ON q.symbol = w.symbol AND q.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(trade_date) FROM daily_prices WHERE symbol = w.symbol AND trade_date < p.trade_date) WHERE w.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY w.sort_order, w.id
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO watchlists (group_id, user_id, symbol, sort_order) VALUES (#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{symbol}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM watchlists WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND symbol = #{symbol})
